app.name: Build My TV Station
login.title: Log in
password.title: Change your password
password.forced: You logged in with a one-time password. Choose your own password to continue.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Set up a complete TV station step by step, and keep an eye on each of its parts.
dashboard.noParts: No parts yet. Start with Create My TV Station, or add a part that already runs under Components.
role.generator.about: Builds the channel and sends it out as an RTMP or SRT stream.
role.distribution.about: Receives the stream and serves it to viewers over HLS, WebRTC, RTSP and SRT.
role.portal.about: Lists the channels for TV boxes and IPTV apps.
wizard.title: Create My TV Station
wizard.step1.title: Where should the station run?
wizard.step1.intro: Choose how the parts of your TV station are hosted. You can change this later by starting over.
wizard.target.proxmox.about: Each part gets its own LXC container on a Proxmox VE server. The panel creates the containers for you.
wizard.target.machines.about: Each part runs on its own VPS or physical machine with Debian 13. The panel installs them over SSH.
components.title: Components
components.intro: Every part of the station that this panel monitors. The panel checks each one every 30 seconds.
components.name: Name
components.confirmDelete: Remove {name} from monitoring? The part itself keeps running.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: The language for users who have not picked one themselves.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.notLoggedIn: Your session has ended. Log in again.
errors.passwordSame: Choose a password that differs from the current one.
errors.language: Choose a language from the list.
errors.target: Choose where the station should run.
errors.componentName: Enter a name of at most 80 characters.
errors.componentUrl: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.jsonOnly: The request was not sent as JSON.
errors.badRequest: The request could not be read.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server.
info.title: Version and updates
info.confirmReinstall: Reinstall the current version? The panel restarts and is unavailable for a moment.
info.availableBanner: A new version of Build My TV Station is available. Open Version and updates to install it.
info.notInstalled: Updating from the panel works on a machine or container set up with the installer. Here, run tvstation-update as root instead.
info.updating: The update is running. The panel restarts and this page reloads on its own when it is back.
errors.updateBranch: The branch {branch} was not found in the repository.
errors.updateUnreachable: The repository could not be reached to check for updates.
errors.updateNotInstalled: Updating from the panel needs the update service from the installer.
wizard.confirmRestart: Start over? Your choices in the wizard are cleared. Nothing on the Proxmox server is removed.
wizard.machines.title: Your machines
wizard.machines.pending: Adding separate machines is the next step in development. For now, go back and choose one Proxmox server, or add parts that already run under Components.
wizard.proxmox.title: Connect to your Proxmox server
wizard.proxmox.intro: The panel logs in to a Proxmox node as root over SSH with a key of its own. It needs that to run the install scripts that create the containers, which only run in a node shell.
wizard.proxmox.keyIntro: Run this once in the shell of the Proxmox node (Datacenter, then the node, then Shell):
wizard.guest.lxc.about: Light and quick to start. Each part is created with its own Proxmox script, the same way as the community-scripts.
wizard.guest.vm.about: Each part gets a full Debian 13 VM and is installed there with its Debian installer. Uses more memory, but is fully separated.
wizard.proxmox.noStorage: This node has no active storage for this type of guest.
wizard.proxmox.poolNew: This pool does not exist yet. The panel creates it when you continue, and puts every guest of the station in it.
wizard.proxmox.poolExists: This pool already exists. Every guest of the station is put in it.
wizard.parts.title: Parts and resources
wizard.parts.pending: Choosing the parts and their resources is the next step in development.
